controls.label: Filter Type
controls.info: The filter: lowpass, highpass, bandpass, notch, a lowpass-bandpass-highpass-notch morph, a one-knob DJ filter, comb, resampling (sample and hold), notch + lowpass, or vowel formants (structural: changing it recompiles the device, crossfaded).

controls.label: Circuit
controls.info: The circuit model: Clean (linear), OSR (state variable, diode-limited resonance), MS2 (Sallen-Key-like, soft-clipped resonance), SMP (a hybrid with even harmonics) or PRD (transistor ladder) (structural).

controls.label: Slope
controls.info: The filter's slope: 12 or 24 dB per octave (structural).
Left of centre a lowpass closes from 20 kHz down to 25 Hz, right of centre a highpass opens from 15 Hz up to 15 kHz; centre: no filtering.
How hard the circuit model's nonlinearity is driven (the level is compensated: drive changes the character, not the loudness).
Morph: lowpass, bandpass, highpass, notch and back. Vowel: the vowel, A E I O U.
The envelope follower moves the frequency with the input's level (structural: off costs nothing).
The envelope follower listens to the sidechain input, mixed with the device's own input (structural).
The LFO moves the frequency (structural: off costs nothing).

controls.label: Shape
controls.info: The LFO's waveform; random holds a new value for each cycle (structural).
Locks the LFO to the song: one cycle per Beats.
Shifts the LFO's phase on both channels.
The right channel's phase against the left: stereo movement.
Runs the right channel's LFO up to 50 % faster than the left.
